input.question: When implementing a Ghost e2e browse test for a new resource (`audit_logs`) that has no pre-defined fixture set and no POST/add endpoint, how should the test create records to validate a non-empty browse response?

options.A: Rely on Ghost's default test database which always contains sample audit log records regardless of fixture initialization.
options.B: Use `agent.post('audit_logs')` with a test payload; Ghost's framework will automatically handle creation even without an explicit add endpoint.
options.C: Create records programmatically via direct model insertion before the browse assertion, since neither a fixture set nor an add endpoint is available.
options.D: Pass a custom fixture file path directly to `fixtureManager.init()` to load audit log records from a local JSON file.
